t: This is Alert, a sculpture by Antony Gormley. Gormley is a British sculptor, and his best-known work is the Angel of the North, a public sculpture in Gateshead, commissioned in 1994 and erected in 1998. He also made Another Place on Crosby Beach near Liverpool, and Event Horizon, which premiered in London in 2007 and later appeared in New York, São Paulo and Hong Kong. Take a moment to look at the piece and how it sits in this spot.
